hookTimeouts.readBy: a hold waits no longer than the agent lets a hook run

continuation.readBy: a stop hold continues at most this many times in one turn

launch.readBy: how DeepBuild starts the agent headless

modelFamily.readBy: which rate card and context window a model name belongs to

billing.readBy: whether a session bills a plan or an API account

usage.readBy: every run prints its cost and is held to its cap
usage.costFrom: nothing: Cursor's hooks carry no usage
usage.tokens: not captured: Cursor's hooks carry no usage

questionTools.readBy: which tool calls are questions to the person, so each one is caught as a permission request of kind question

transcripts.readBy: a run keeps its session's own transcript
transcripts.path: none: Cursor's hooks do not name a transcript

errorTexts.readBy: a stop's cause from the texts the agent writes; a stop that matches none is unknown, never a pass

events.readBy: each hook's strict payload schema per covered version; a missing or retyped field, or an event not listed, reads unverified and the session's holds go watch-only, naming the field; an unlisted field is only a reading

mapping.readBy: the adapter maps each hook payload to events by these entries, and deep explain names the entry behind each event; a value names a payload field, or =text a constant

toolKinds.readBy: a tool call's kind (shell, read, edit, write, search, fetch, mcp or unknown, which guards treat as change), by tool name or name prefix

toolDetail.readBy: what a call of each kind carries: a shell call's command, a file call's paths
